description.purpose: The round table of the builder's tool loop: one row per turn of one build. `build_id` correlates every row of one wish, `iter` names the round inside it, `role` is one of five: `user`, `assistant` and `tool` are the loop itself; `receipt` is a refusal handed back by the submitter, which belongs in the rebuilt thread but is not a tool answer, so no round set counts it; `manifest` is the binding row `normalise` writes when it mints a digest (`manifest_sha256` beside the `build_id`), which is how a later round finds the build a refusal is talking about. `turn` is the JSON-serialised UBF turn (or the array of assistant tool-call turns), and `fired` is the compare-and-set guard that grants exactly one weave path permission to cross the re-entry edge.
description.use_when: Beside `weave`, inside the builder hive. Never addressed from outside: the hive is sealed and this cell has no lane of its own.
description.not_in_scope: No retention policy and no pruning: a build is minutes long, not a session. No reading by anything but `weave` -- a second reader would be a second protocol over the same guard.
